blurb: Fly In Helicopters offers aerial tours over Charleston, South Carolina, providing panoramic views of historic downtown, barrier islands, and landmarks like the Ravenel Bridge and Fort Sumter. Flights are conducted over water for safety, with all passengers equipped with inflatable floats and life preservers. The company is locally owned, FAA-compliant, and has a perfect safety record.
